# Colour picker triggers (see common/scripted_effects/rn_colour_picker.txt).

# ROOT (player) scope: a colour picker is open and nothing else blocks it.
rn_cp_is_open = {
	is_ai = no
	NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_open }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input }
	OR = { has_country_flag = rn_cp_open_own has_country_flag = rn_cp_open_sub }
}

# Scope: the country whose colour changes. Its colour cooldown is still running.
rn_cp_cooldown_active = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_left = rn_ip_cd_colour_until }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_left = global.num_days }
	check_variable = { rn_ip_cd_left > 0 }
}

# Whose colour the player may change (scope: the country, ROOT: the player), by the colour rule
# rn_feature_colour. The host switches themselves (colour off, "other countries" off) are checked
# apart (rn_cp_switch), so that a refusal says which one it is.
#   RN_FEATURE_COLOUR_ON (default)  own country and own subjects
#   RN_FEATURE_COLOUR_OWN           own country only
#   RN_FEATURE_COLOUR_ANY           as the default, and the host changes every country
# The host: the only human in single player, or the player whose CAPIE command carried
# capie_host = 1 (rn_rights_host, as for the rename rights).
rn_cp_may_edit = {
	exists = yes
	OR = {
		tag = ROOT
		AND = {
			NOT = { rn_feature_colour_own_only = yes }
			is_subject_of = ROOT
		}
		AND = {
			rn_feature_colour_any = yes
			ROOT = { rn_rights_host = yes }
		}
	}
}
